message_excerpt: NIFI-16148 Aligned Parameter Context Update Authorization (#11479)
proposition: POST /parameter-contexts/{contextId}/update-requests: contract says updating a parameter context requires read permission for current and newly inherited parameter contexts; implementation does the update authorization callback checks the context, affected components and service references without checking inherited-context read permission
inference_notes: ⚠️ Dispatch, validation and serialization inferred statically; no upstream execution.
